blocking.section: Distributed state catalog > State client and RZ-STS error codes
blocking.issue: The earlier fix added the 502 response-Phase case but still limits every RZ-STS code to 503 or 502. Pack 8.10 gives 401 or 403 for a closed failure of an auth or authz type in a request Phase, and a `plugin` Policy with `filterClass` `auth` or `authz` is such a type. Pack 8.6, WASM plugin system line 103 and Data plane line 439 use `STS` whenever that Plugin's `state_get` or `state_incr` fails or times out, or the open breaker skips it with `ERR_UNAVAILABLE`. The registry therefore reports the wrong status for an auth-class or authz-class Plugin whose State Store call fails.

Pack 8.10: security types include "`plugin` Policies with `filterClass` `auth` or `authz`". 05-wasm-plugin-system.md line 103: "A negative guest result uses `RZ-STS` only when its State Store call was attempted and failed or timed out, or the open breaker skipped it".

Change each Status cell of RZ-STS-001 to RZ-STS-005 to "503, 502 in a response Phase; 401 or 403 for an auth-class or authz-class Plugin".
